arxiv-2207-10245.description: Abstract Detecting and mitigating harmful biases in modern language models are widely recognized as crucial, open problems. pmc-13061081.creator: Diana Bućan, Ivan Bućan
pmc-13061081.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Following a regular occupational health checkup, a 63-year-old worker employed at petrol station for thirty years was diagnosed with chronic lymphocytic leukaemia (CLL). The patient’s occupational history revealed long-term daily exposure to petroleum-derived vapours. As part of a routine occupational health assessment, he underwent comprehensive laboratory testing, followed by further evaluation and treatment by a haematologist, including a myelogram, immunophenotyping of haemoblastosis, and bone marrow histopathology. Based on the completed diagnostic workup, the patient was diagnosed CLL with B-cell predominance.
